governing_objective: Integrate durable terminal process supervision into KCH and prove the exact component in source and in a fresh portable installation before any new real-session campaign.

chronology.cause: Two stale governance-count assertions expected 19 nodes after the new constitutional rule made the correct count 20.

The Windows virtual-environment launcher PID differed from the effective supervisor PID sealed in the terminal receipt. KCH correctly failed closed instead of calling physical success governed success.

established: The R19 source implementation passes its complete local suite under owned terminal supervision.
The packaged wheel installs offline in a fresh short-path Windows runtime.
The installed Super-MCP exposes 283 tools including launch, bounded wait and evidence operations.

Exit code, stdout, stderr and expected artifact hashes agree between monitor, terminal receipt and independent reads.

PHL remains authorized but untrained and was not executed.
not_established: Host-wide automatic interposition across Codex, Cline, Cowork, OpenCode or other clients.
Long-duration reliability, crash recovery across operating-system reboot, or heterogeneous-platform equivalence.
Industrial, production, safety or universal efficacy.
Prevention of every recurrent agent failure outside the tested terminal-supervision class.
adjudication.comparison_note: This is a chronological defect-repair adjudication, not a competing-arm superiority experiment.
